changes_made.explanation: Removed baseline models (Pointer Generator, Fast-Abs) and EDUSum sel+RL (ablation study variant) from models list since only EDUSum is the main model being evaluated. Simplified output description.
Normalized all ROUGE variants to base ROUGE metric following simplification guidelines
No LLM evaluation used in this 2020 paper

guideline: Readability measures how easy a text is to read, and depends on the elements of grammaticality and coherence
Non-redundancy mainly denotes the degree of linguistic brevity of a text in conveying the main idea
Three annotators rank summaries with respect to readability and non-redundancy, with ties allowed

changes_made.explanation: Guidelines and criteria correctly extracted and normalized

overall_notes: Paper focuses on abstractive summarization using Elementary Discourse Units (EDUs). Extraction was generally accurate but included baseline models that shouldn't be in the main models list. Human evaluation was well-documented with clear criteria. No LLM evaluation used (expected for 2020 paper).
